item.description: As days of dangerous heat become more frequent in Japan, Sendai has emerged as the most comfortable city, with a climate that is “not too hot and not too cold”. The Miyagi prefectural capital, about 300km (186 miles) from Tokyo, has the best weather, according to the Asahi newspaper, with the lowest number of midsummer and midwinter days among 11 major cities in the nation. item.title: Minnesota farmer's 300-acre farm at centre of will dispute; 2026 court ruling reverses estate reopening
item.description: In a significant Minnesota inheritance case, the state Court of Appeals has reinstated a 2017 ruling concerning the estate of farmer Clarence Vatthauer. Disputes arose from conflicting wills dated 1982 and 1989, leading to a previous court's decision being vacated. The appeals court's ruling underscored the necessity of procedural compliance and the need for finality in estate administration, reshaping the understanding of inheritance law. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Artist bought a Giacometti chandelier for £250 in London; decades later, it sold for £2.922 million
item.description: A chandelier created by Alberto Giacometti sold for £2.922 million at a Christie's auction in February 2023. Originally purchased for £250 by British artist John Craxton in the 1960s, it remained in his family until his death. The chandelier was commissioned by art patron Peter Watson for the literary magazine Horizon, which published many famous authors. It underwent extensive authentication process before its auction, confirming its historical significance. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Leafy spurge may have arrived in North America through a Massachusetts ballast dump in 1827
item.description: Leafy spurge is an invasive plant that was first recorded in Newbury, Massachusetts, in 1827. It spread rapidly across the northern United States and southern Canada during the early 1900s. By this time, it was established in several states and regions, including Ontario and Iowa. The plant has significant ecological impacts, often replacing native vegetation and causing issues for grazing animals. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
